company.shortDescription: XLR8 WELLNESS provides diagnostics, at-home medical care, IV therapy, and wellness services for individuals and hospitality partners.
company.description:
XLR8 WELLNESS: Redefining Longevity & Performance Medicine

​XLR8 WELLNESS bridges the gap between hospital-grade diagnostics and luxury convenience, delivering comprehensive health services directly to your home or through our curated on-site experiences. We specialize in optimizing human biology through a fusion of advanced medical science and holistic care.

​Our ecosystem spans from clinical concierge services—including at-home blood testing, IV drips, and nurse visits—to cutting-edge biohacking and peptide therapies designed for cellular regeneration and cognitive precision. Beyond individual care, we engineer immersive wellness retreats and partner with luxury hotels to design neuro-fitness protocols that maximize healthspan. Whether addressing fertility, cardiac risk, or elite physical performance, XLR8 WELLNESS provides the blueprint for a longer, healthier life.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $12,034,711, or 70.9% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,979,214 to $66,199,654, a 22.22x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
